payload.title: FUN-recordings: public-process proof for Recordings after INV→CLN→DEL vertical completion
payload.ask: After INV-REC-TOPLEVEL, CLN-REC-FOLD-SERVICE, CLN-REC-LEGACY-PACKAGES, CLN-REC-CONTRACT-ROOTS, and DEL-REC Factory completion, prove from an external-user perspective that Recordings still works: record/replay lifecycle, canonical event/artifact/projection-query surfaces, portable recording build/validate, and HTTP/CLI/MCP Recordings transports remain inert until runtime lifecycle, then activate through public Recordings protocol surfaces constructed only via root.BuildProcess and edges.Edges—without inventing root/wire test subsystems or peer-importing recordings/internal or deleted transitional Recordings packages (service/, artifacts/, events/, projections/, replay/ public roots).
systemShapeRequirements: Keep packaged Recordings root as wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts; do not fold or delete packages in this packet
Do not invent new pkg/root or pkg/wire Recordings helper APIs solely for tests
Functional proofs construct the process only through root.BuildProcess and replace effects only via edges.Edges
Do not invent Recordings HTTP/CLI/MCP adapters (transports/ already present; adapters are not this packet) or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX
Do not revive deleted recordings transitional siblings (service/, artifacts/, events/, projections/, replay/ public roots) or reopen CLN-REC / DEL-REC deletion leases
Do not reopen CUT-RUN-REC / CUT-WORK-REC / CUT-VIS-REC consumer cuts
testCoverageRequirements: Own proofs under tests/functional/recordings (establish focused suite if absent); first validate existing tests/functional/replay_contracts and smoke/cli record-replay coverage as the primary historical home and retarget/extend only for public-process gaps

First validate whether existing functional proofs already cover inert construction and post-lifecycle activation for record/replay, event/artifact surfaces, portable recording validate/build, and HTTP/CLI/MCP Recordings transports; add only missing external proofs
Do not substitute packaged_root_shape, del_rec_* gate tests, peer-import scanners, or unit-only thin-root proofs for external behavior proof
Do not invent a new peer/root/wire Recordings test subsystem or a second suite topology that duplicates replay_contracts without consolidating ownership
acceptanceCriteria: Record/replay lifecycle and Recordings HTTP/CLI/MCP transport surfaces have external functional proof of inert construction and post-lifecycle activation through public Recordings surfaces (behavioral)

No functional-suite or production peer import of deleted Recordings transitional packages (service/, artifacts/, events/, projections/, replay/ public roots) or recordings/internal from outside the Recordings owner
Packaged Recordings root remains wire/, internal/, transports/ plus thin root contracts
Typecheck, lint, and required CI are terminal green; PR merged before Factory completion
outOfScope: New pkg/root or pkg/wire Recordings composition helpers created only to make tests compile
FUN-workers / FUN-settings / FUN-definitions / FUN-work (separate owner gates)
Reopening CLN-REC, DEL-REC, CUT-RUN-REC, CUT-WORK-REC, or CUT-VIS-REC
antiPatterns: Treating DEL-REC merge alone as FUN-recordings complete without public-process proof
Building a root/wire 'RecordingsRootFromEdges' subsystem because tests asked for public composition
Treating packaged_root_shape or del_rec_* unit gates as sufficient FUN proof without external lifecycle behavior
Peer-importing recordings/internal or deleted transitional Recordings packages from functional suites
Leaving replay_contracts or other suites importing deleted service/artifacts/events/projections/replay public roots without retargeting to public Recordings surfaces
Inventing protocol adapters or reopening accepted CLI UX under a FUN lease
Folding/deleting residual dirs under a FUN lease
Touching live WRK-CONTRACT / DEL-WRK / DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL / RET-DEF-ROOT-WIRE / FUN-settings / PSS-I0* under a FUN lease
currentProgress: INV-REC-TOPLEVEL, CLN-REC-FOLD-SERVICE, CLN-REC-LEGACY-PACKAGES, CLN-REC-CONTRACT-ROOTS, and DEL-REC are Factory-terminal (DEL-REC PR #1647 merged 4f64dc9a8; idea/plan/task/review complete).

On origin/main tip after DEL-REC, pkg/services/recordings public directories are exactly wire/, internal/, transports/; service/, artifacts/, events/, projections/, and replay/ public roots are gone; packaged_root_shape / del_rec_* gates lock the deletion.
Recordings transports/ already exposes cli/http/mcp; CUT-RUN-REC (#1644) and related consumer cuts are Factory-terminal; FUN closes the vertical with explicit public-process proof.

Existing tests/functional/replay_contracts plus smoke/cli record-replay and work/recordings-read cover historical record/replay behavior; dedicated tests/functional/recordings is absent — FUN must validate/extend public-process inertness + lifecycle under an owned Recordings suite home without inventing a duplicate topology.

Customer ask after REC toplevel cleanup prefers FUN-recordings when prerequisites are clear; free executor capacity exists while WRK-CONTRACT, DEL-DEF-RESIDUAL, RET-DEF, and FUN-settings lanes progress naturally.

payload.requestedOutcome: Prove Recordings as a packaged service through public process composition only: root.BuildProcess, public Recordings protocol surfaces (HTTP/CLI/MCP transports already present), and edges.Edges effect replacement. Validate and, only where needed, establish/extend focused functional proofs under tests/functional/recordings (and retarget existing tests/functional/replay_contracts / smoke record-replay proofs) so record/replay lifecycle, event/artifact/projection-query surfaces, portable recording build/validate, and Recordings transports remain inert until runtime lifecycle starts, then exercise public Recordings behavior without importing recordings/internal or deleted transitional Recordings packages (service/, artifacts/, events/, projections/, replay/ public roots) from outside the owner and without inventing pkg/root or pkg/wire test-only composition helpers. Confirm no production peer reaches Recordings through deleted transitional packages. Do not fold or delete packages. Do not invent Recordings protocol adapters or reopen accepted Schema-Driven/Clean CLI UX. Do not open PSS-I0* shared integrators. Delivery contract: loop implementation and review until required CI is terminal green, every blocking PR conversation comment is addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file churn are reconciled, the PR is merged, and only then complete Factory work.
